features.scaling: StandardScaler fit on training partition only for logistic regression and RBF SVM; no scaling for random forest

validation.method: existing immutable StratifiedGroupKFold assignments from protocol-mic-01 audit
validation.reporting: pooled OOF metrics and every fold metric; fold-wise mean is descriptive only; no confidence interval or formal inferential claim

scope_limits: exploratory baseline only; not a formal model release or publication-ready result
the indivisible 293-molecule homology component remains intact in its assigned fold
no ESM embeddings, external holdout, model selection, threshold selection, calibration, or post-hoc filtering
results are conditional on the current evidence-screened cohort and its highly imbalanced homology-group fold sizes
release_gate: This protocol authorizes only the fixed exploratory baseline run. It does not change the blocked status of the original dual-task formal study.
